payload.title: Make human actions atomic and auditable
payload.description:
As an account operator, I want human decisions to be durable and race-safe, so that procedures act on one authorized response with current evidence.

Feature: Authoritative human action requests

Scenario: Accept one account response
  Given an open action with current preconditions
  When two authenticated users from the same account respond concurrently
  Then exactly one valid response is accepted
  And the winning responder and events are recorded
  And the other response is reported as already resolved

Scenario: Reject unsafe responses
  Given an action is stale, expired, cancelled, or belongs to another account
  When a user attempts to respond
  Then the response is not accepted
  And no dependent procedure or mutation resumes
